# Preparing weekday lunches

Plan a few meals that share ingredients without making every lunch identical. Cook components in batches, label containers with preparation dates and keep a short list of what is already available. Leave room for changing plans so unused portions do not accumulate.

The shopping list should follow the actual menu rather than an idealized week. A simple inventory on the refrigerator is often enough. Record which combinations were convenient and adjust the next plan from experience. This notebook concerns organization, not nutritional or medical advice.
